title: Why Cash Gets Tight After the Holidays

scenes.say: December is your best month. It can set up your worst one.

props.label: CASH FLOW
props.line: Your best month can set up *your worst*.

scenes.say: Say December brings in forty thousand dollars. January? Twenty-four. But rent, payroll and the December bills all land the same week.
A great December feels like extra money. Most of it is next month's rent and last month's bills.

props.caption: Myth or *fact*?
props.myth: A big December means money to spare
props.fact: Much of it is already owed in January

scenes.say: So: set aside some of December's cash before you touch it. Pay the December bills in December. And plan a reason to visit in January.

props.title: Before January
steps: Plan a January reason to visit
